title: MapleStory M Change Options Guide
author: MapleStory M GM
summary: Official potential-option guidance explaining appraisal, cubes and scrolls, option grades, equipment restrictions, Meso costs, manual rerolls, and the automatic option-change function.

sections.title: Potential and option basics
items: Appraised equipment can use cubes or scrolls to change potential abilities.
Available options and values differ by equipment piece.
Some cube types can raise potential grade at a low probability.

sections.title: Access and costs
items: Open Change Options from Bag > Equipment > Forge or Main Menu > Forge > Change Options.
Changing options consumes Mesos and the selected Cube.
Potential Scrolls can replace previous options, so the current state must be checked before use.

sections.title: Manual change process
items: Select equipment whose potential has already been appraised.
Select a compatible Cube and review the change interface.
Locked equipment cannot have its options changed.

sections.title: Cube and automatic-change limits
items: Occult Cubes cannot be used when potential is Unique rank or higher.
Unique and Legendary Potential Scrolls follow equipment-rank and current-potential requirements.
Automatic change can repeatedly use owned cubes until the selected rank or option condition is reached.

notes: Structured summary verified from Nexon's official MapleStory M forum guide on 2026-07-27.
prerequisites: A compatible Cube or Potential Scroll
steps: Open Forge and select Change Options.
Select an appraised, unlocked equipment item.
Choose a compatible Cube or scroll.
Review the current options, target, cost, and restrictions.
Change options manually or configure the automatic-change condition.
